scope: Pre-outcome causal/preregistration and focused evaluator review only. Root owns launch authorization.
resolved_finding: Manifest validation now requires exact full authoritative SHA-256; prefix fallback removed.
checks: Closed-1H confirmation origin follows extreme; activation freezes each leg threshold; first left-truncated leg excluded and gap/end censoring retained.
Phase/clock share full observed anchor-to-confirmation physical history; state includes durations and amplitude; no future event completion normalization.

Common eligible event pool and scaler restricted to labels mature by min(fold fit cutoff, earliest actual feature history); input support includes full event prefix and 336h closed-4H engineered dependency.
Evaluation preserves original three folds and requires full label horizon <= fold endpoint, bounded by 2026-05-01; entry at origin+minute OPEN.
Existing stop-conditioned conservative lower Q and full-horizon SL-touch targets unchanged across arms; upper intraminute Q sensitivity separate.
Neighbors deterministic, max32 and >=72h origin separation; min8 or same empirical-prior fallback retained in every all-ID score denominator; prior smoothing weight8.
One query per confirmed event; paired event losses bootstrap within fold using occupied14d blocks, seed7 and1000 draws;28d sensitivity also emitted.
Success requires BOTH TP pinball and SL Brier versus EACH prior/state/clock, primaryCI upper<0 and >=2/3fold negative, plus >=90% supported coverage in each state/clock/phase arm.
No economic/native/VPS/pilot/CHECK changes or model training in reviewed scope.
limitations: This is repeatedly studied DEVELOPMENT research, not a new untouched holdout or evidence of event-timing superiority/ROI.
Fourteen-day occupied-block bootstrap is the preregistered dependence approximation;28d sensitivity and event-neighbor reuse are reported.
Empty eligible/unambiguous prior raises explicit infeasibility rather than fabricating forecasts.
